mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rates above 7% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 7% in elevated unemployment periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) above their 5-year averages indicates robust economic growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p < 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceed their 5-year averages in expansionary phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in CPIAUCSL below 2.0% during late-cycle expansion signals cooling inflation, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when CPIAUCSL drops below 2.0 in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in HOUST below 700 units indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when HOUST drops below 700 in stable demand environment.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS above 4% and UNRATE above 7.5% signals tightening monetary policy and labor market stress, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not negative when FEDFUNDS >4% and UNRATE>7.5% in tightening monetary periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above its 5-year average reflects strong supply growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not positive when INDPRO exceeds its 5-year average in strong supply growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in RSAFS during post-shock recovery periods signals reduced demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when RSAFS drops in post-shock recovery.
